- Added `src/point_add/trailmix_port/`, a small local port of the TrailMix shrunken-PZ point-add stack adapted to the challenge builder and op model.
- Switched `point_add::build()` to emit this TrailMix route by default. The old dialog route remains available via `POINT_ADD_DIALOG_ROUTE=1`.

- Added a runtime-generated thin shrunken-PZ schedule:
  - deterministic training sample,
  - 500,000-sample row repair pass,
  - full CLZ/shift windows retained for safety,
  - 8-bit done counter,
  - fixed 48-bit identity nonce tail set to nonce 2.
- Added a count-only Fiat-Shamir hash diagnostic and TrailMix support filter used to find the nonce-2 seed whose actual 9024 verifier inversion factors all fit the thin schedule.
- Replaced the highest-pressure TrailMix classical-register add paths with zero-temp direct creg add/sub paths to keep the peak under 1000.
